[EN] You want a gilded feather? Sorry, but I made myself a promise: I don't make those anymore.

It's the downy struthio feathers, you see: The Shariar made struthio-poaching illegal. It's not worth it to me to invoke their wrath."But I already have this feather..."
[ES] ¿Quieres una pluma dorada? Lo siento, pero me hice una promesa: ya no hago esas.

Son las plumas suaves de struthio, ¿ves? Los Shariar declararon ilegal la caza furtiva de struthio. No vale la pena para mí atraer su ira."But I already have this feather..."

[EN] You've already got the feather? Well, the Shariar only enforce the "no-hunt" law, so I guess I could make one more."Great news."
[ES] ¿Ya tienes la pluma? Bueno, los Shariar solo hacen cumplir la ley de "no cazar", supongo que podría hacer una más."Great news."

[EN] Sorry, but the valiant fighters of the Shariar made struthio-hunting a crime. My advice is to sell off your xermetal ore and luria fibers and forget all about struthio feathers.
[ES] Lo siento, pero los valientes combatientes de los Shariar hicieron que cazar struthios sea un delito. Mi consejo es que vendas tu xermetal ore y luria fibras y te olvides por completo de las struthio feathers.
